messages.subject: multiple graphics & captions
parts:
I've played around a bit with graphics and tables, and have managed sucessfully to tweak things to my taste. There is one issue that I think is final:

I have a data frame with a host of variables that are tested using various measures, basically as follows:

<<test-for-normality-and-stuff>>=
sapply(colnames(mydataframe),function(X) {
x <- mydataframe[X]

corplot ...
qplot ... 
qqplot ...

etcplot ...

)
<<>>

Now, just saying cat("\\begin{figure}") first and cat("\\end{figure}") last doesn't quite cut it … because cat and the plots are not executed in sequence, so I get lots of empty table enviroments and then orphaned figures.

I hope I have made clear what I want. All and any suggestions higly appreceated.

Thank you,

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] multiple graphics & captions
parts:
That is only because you used the chunk option fig.show='hold', which
means all plots go to the end of the output:
http://yihui.name/knitr/options

Remove that option and you will no longer get the empty figure environments.

Regards,
Yihui
